title: NBP and Habib University Foundation Partner for Women's Education
excerpt: The National Bank of Pakistan has signed an MoU with the Habib University Foundation to support higher education for young women.
body_html:
The National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Habib University Foundation. The agreement aims to broaden access to higher education for young women.

Through this collaboration, both organizations seek to empower female students by creating educational opportunities. Details regarding specific funding amounts, scholarship numbers, or program durations were not disclosed in the announcement.
